questions.stem: Which statement is one of Virchow's principles for reforming medicine?

options.A: Health is primarily the responsibility of the individual patient
options.B: Social conditions affect health but lie outside scientific study
options.C: Disease prevention belongs to the state, not to physicians
options.D: Measures to promote health and combat disease must be social as well as medical
options.E: Epidemics are best controlled by medical measures such as quarantine

questions.explanation: Virchow's three principles: the people's health is a matter of direct social concern; social and economic conditions affect health and must be scientifically investigated; and measures must be social as well as medical. A: He made health a social concern. B: He insisted these relations be studied scientifically. C: He saw the physician as the natural advocate for the poor. E: He called for social, not only medical, measures.

questions.stem: What did Virchow conclude caused the 1848 typhus epidemic in Upper Silesia?
questions.explanation: He traced it to poverty and underdevelopment, recommending education, freedom, and welfare. B, C, D, E: Not his conclusions.

questions.stem: Higher HIV rates among low-income women who exchange sex for food are best described as:

options.B: A health disparity without a social cause

questions.explanation: A disparity is any difference in health outcomes; an inequity is the type closely linked with social or economic disadvantage, here poverty driving transactional sex. A, C: The cause is social, not biological. B: The difference has a clear socioeconomic cause. D: Too narrow; the driver is limited economic opportunity.

questions.stem: Which public-health achievement is credited to Virchow?

options.B: Legislation creating the Chilean National Health Service
options.C: Berlin city sewage systems and mandatory meat inspection
options.D: Founding the Latin American Social Medicine Association
options.E: Training physicians in 'revolutionary medicine' in Cuba

questions.explanation: Virchow's accomplishments: city sewage systems, mandatory meat inspection, ventilation and heating of public buildings, school health services, and better working conditions for nurses. A, B: Allende. D: Reformers from Juan Cesar Garcia's seminar group (1984). E: Che Guevara.

questions.stem: Unemployment among people living with HIV/AIDS ranges from 45% to 65%. Which relationship between SES and HIV does this illustrate?

options.D: Rural residence affects access to HIV care

questions.explanation: HIV status can lower SES by constraining the ability to work and earn income. A: Limited economic opportunity leading to risky sex. C: Low SES delaying treatment and lowering adherence. D: Distance, few HIV-expert providers, stigma. E: A cause of infection, not an effect on SES.
